issues.problem: Intro listed お〜ください as the 'lightest' of four honorific tools on one respect scale; it is a request form, not a degree of respect.
issues.action: Rewrote: three tools ranked by respect, お〜ください introduced separately for requests.

issues.problem: Missing uchi-soto exception: to an outsider, one's own boss is treated as one's own side (humble 申しておりました, not おっしゃいました).
issues.action: Added to intro and to the 申す contrast note.

issues.problem: kg-son-special explain said the special verb replaces regular forms 'completely'; 行かれる / 来られる are in common, correct use.
issues.action: Changed to 'is preferred over the regular patterns'.

issues.problem: kg-o-kudasai explain gave いらっしゃってください as the request for come; the standard business/sign form お越しください was missing.
issues.action: Replaced with お越しください or おいでください (for come).

issues.problem: kg-o-kudasai tip 'two-kanji Sino-Japanese word: ご' contradicts the お電話 exception given in explain.
issues.action: Tip now reads 'Sino-Japanese word: ご (except お電話)'.
